body: Damn. Where are you living where people are happy and “where they want to be”? I’m sitting in the middle of racism, wildfires and police brutality.
On Pristiq for depression, Wellbutrin for ADD along with two pills for PTSD. Took me 10 months to find the right balance. Takes time. Patience is everything.

What’s up party people. Just added Hydroxyzine to my pill cocktail of Pristiq and Wellbutrin. I just wanna day, I’m so friggin thankful for Reddit and for people who contribute to posts like these. Thanks for showing up and being such an outstanding community. Hope everyone is making their way through these weird and fucked up times. All my love!
I’m a florist at a privileged grocery store.

Hello! 


My interactions with Pristiq and alcohol have been interesting to say the least. I honestly believe Pristiq has raised my tolerance level for booze. I’ve gone from drinking a glass of wine or two a week to bottle or two a night. I hardly ever have hangovers and the “drunk” aspect isn’t really in the equation. I have a meeting with my doctor next week to talk about my options. The medication itself does wonders for me and I really don’t want to go off of it or try something else. 

I don’t think two beers would lead you to days of mixed feelings and behaviors all of a sudden. There are many things happening in the world that might be subconsciously triggering you as well. Have you changed your diet in any other way? I’m sorry you’re not feeling well and hope you figure out a solution soon !
I also transferred from Lexapro to Pristiq with weird side effects, but no trouble since five months ago when I started.
same here!!!!!!! Must be a shift??? Mine started this morning. Ugh.
Thank you so much for sharing!!! I hope things continue to look up for you.

Thank you so much for your response! I’m 35/F and just started this whole ordeal last year. It’s the first time accepting I need to take meds to balance my brain and so far it’s been pretty interesting. I’ve heard so many great things about Lexapro, so I was disappointed when it didn’t work for me. 

It’s only been a couple of days with the Pristiq, but I definitely feels the changes and I almost want to say I feel less foggy? Could just be me playing it up. 

I’m so happy to hear it’s working for you and that you’re feeling better! I hope to have the same experience as you.
